label: qf-autoqf-step-preview-media-type
note: ATC autoqf step=preview refuses application/vnd.sap.adt.atc.objectreferences.v1+xml and names the type it wants: application/vnd.sap.adt.atc.autoqf.selection.v1+xml. Records the step vocabulary without executing a mass fix.
capturedBy: scratchpad probes for the Phase 0 feasibility gate, driven through src/adt/connection.ts AbapConnection against the A4H sandbox appliance. REAL wire recording - not synthetic.
requestHeadersNote: Only caller-supplied headers are listed. Authorization, Cookie, X-CSRF-Token and X-sap-adt-sessiontype were added by the connection layer and are deliberately not recorded.
requestUrlNote: Path and query only; the appliance host/IP is deliberately not recorded.
baitSourceNote: The ABAP source echoed inside requestBody is BAIT invented for this probe (program ZMCP_QF_PROBE1 in $TMP, created and deleted by the probe). It is not customer code and is not a repository artefact.
responseStatusNote: The probe harness did not preserve the HTTP status for this error response; the connection layer raised before it was read. The body is the server's verbatim error text. Recorded as null rather than guessed.
